item.title: 'She Loves Me' brings vibrant romantic comedy to center stage
item.description: "She Loves Me," Brown Musical Forum's most recent show, has something for everyone to love. item.title: A star's final game day: Landon Lewis '26 reflects on his remarkable Brown basketball career
item.description: As the whistle blew in the waning minutes of the men's basketball team's (9-18, 3-11 Ivy) season-finale against Penn (16-11, 12-2) this past Friday, a chorus of cheers filled the Pizzitola Sports Center. item.title: Murray '29: Embracing Brown's culture means embracing 'pre-personalism'
item.description: Brown does things differently.We call majors concentrations, we are one of four universities bearing the name of a color and our Open Curriculum requires no core classes. item.title: R.I. House Speaker introduces 2026 housing legislation package
item.description: On Feb. 26, Rhode Island House Speaker Joseph Shekarchi announced a package of nine bills that aim to address the ongoing housing and homelessness crisis in Rhode Island through policies such as encampment protections and municipal building reuse. item.title: U.S. spent roughly $3.4 trillion in military competition with China between 2012 and 2024, Watson study estimates
item.description: The United States spent an estimated $3.4 trillion to compete militarily with China between 2012 and 2024, according to a Costs of War report by Jennifer Kavanagh, the director of military analysis at Defense Priorities, a foreign policy think tank.
